title: Event
description: An observational event fired by the bridge (sender-originated, no ack expected). Frozen from docs/seed.md §Event example (selection.changed). timestamp is REQUIRED on events (sender-originated). $comment: only selection.changed is frozen in Phase 1 (the 1-event spike honestly validates this); additional event types are Phase 2-extensible (Pitfall 4 — do not over-freeze guesses).
$comment: Phase 2 freezes the 5-event observational set: selection.changed (cursor triple), track.name_changed / clip.name_changed / device.name_changed (windowed-bank + cursor name observers), transport.changed (Transport observers). PROBE-01 (Phase 1) confirmed the observer surface; Plan 02 (bridge) emits all 5. The payload is an additive permissive union (slot/name/playing added in Plan 02 so the 4 new event types can carry their observed state — the Phase-1 payload was selection.changed-only and could not represent a transport flag or a name); additionalProperties stays false to preserve the trust-spine (T-2-02-E). Pitfall 1: every entry here MUST also appear in daemon/src/protocol/reader.ts OBSERVATIONAL_EVENT_TYPES — the equality is unit-tested in schemas.test.ts so the drop-oldest backpressure classifies new events correctly. The envelope-level oneOf discriminator + this schema's type enum remain the extension point for future phases.

timestamp.description: Unix-seconds, sender-originated. Required on every event.

payload.description: Event payload. Fields are a permissive union across the 5 observational event types (all optional). selection.changed carries trackId/clipId/deviceId (legacy identity) + slot (raw cursor position). *.name_changed carry name (+ slot for windowed-bank tracks). transport.changed carries playing. slot is a RAW Bitwig position index — NOT a stable id; the daemon computes STATE-04 fingerprints from it (Pitfall 2).

trackId.description: Raw identity string for selection.changed (kept for backward-compat with the Phase-1 captured round-trip).

slot.description: Raw Bitwig position index (cursor or windowed-bank slot). NOT a stable id.

name.description: Observed name for track/clip/device name_changed events.

playing.description: Transport play state for transport.changed (from Transport.isPlaying()).
